purpose: Curated source-bound evaluation captures for local Memory Retrieval. Text is concise selected evidence, not AI-generated synthesis.

captures.title: Docker overview
captures.text: Docker is a platform for developing, shipping, and running applications in containers. Containers package an application with its dependencies so it can run consistently across environments.

captures.title: Docker Compose overview
captures.text: Docker Compose lets you define and run multi-container applications from a single YAML file. The compose file describes services, networks, volumes, and configuration.

captures.title: Manage Docker as a non-root user
captures.text: The Docker daemon socket is owned by root. To run Docker commands without sudo, add the user to the docker group, then log out and back in or activate the new group membership.

captures.title: Kubernetes overview
captures.text: Kubernetes is an open-source system for automating deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications. A cluster has a control plane and worker nodes.

captures.title: Pods
captures.text: A Pod is Kubernetes smallest deployable unit. A Pod can contain one or more containers that share networking and storage resources.

captures.title: FastAPI async
captures.text: Use async def for path operation functions when the library being called supports await. Use normal def for blocking libraries that do not support await.

captures.title: FastAPI testing
captures.text: FastAPI applications can be tested with TestClient and pytest. Tests make HTTP requests against the application without running a real server process.

captures.title: SQLite WAL mode
captures.text: Write-ahead logging allows readers and a writer to operate concurrently because changes are appended to a WAL file before being checkpointed into the main database.

captures.title: SQLite FTS5
captures.text: FTS5 is SQLite full-text search. It provides virtual tables that can be queried with MATCH and ranked using the bm25 auxiliary function.

captures.title: Python virtual environments
captures.text: The venv module creates lightweight isolated Python environments. Each environment has its own installed packages and can be activated for a project.

captures.title: Python logging
captures.text: Python logging lets applications report events with severity levels such as DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, and CRITICAL. Libraries should use named loggers rather than configuring global logging themselves.

captures.title: CORS guide
captures.text: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing is an HTTP-header mechanism that lets a server indicate which origins may access a resource from browser JavaScript. Browsers can send a preflight request before some cross-origin requests.

captures.title: Fetch API
captures.text: The Fetch API provides a JavaScript interface for making network requests. A fetch promise resolves when headers arrive, so callers should check response.ok before reading a successful response body.

captures.title: OWASP injection prevention
captures.text: Injection flaws happen when untrusted data is sent to an interpreter as part of a command or query. Parameterized queries and safe APIs separate data from commands.

captures.title: OWASP authentication guidance
captures.text: Authentication controls should protect credentials, provide generic error messages, rate limit repeated failed attempts, and use secure session management after login.

captures.title: Git merge
captures.text: git merge joins two or more development histories together. When histories have diverged, Git creates a merge commit unless a fast-forward update is possible.

captures.title: Git rebase
captures.text: git rebase reapplies commits onto another base commit. Rebasing rewrites commit history, so avoid rebasing commits that have already been shared unless collaborators agree.

captures.title: PostgreSQL indexes
captures.text: Indexes can speed up queries that search for rows using indexed columns, but they add overhead to writes and consume storage. The query planner decides whether an index is useful for a query.

captures.title: NGINX reverse proxy
captures.text: A reverse proxy receives client requests and forwards them to an upstream server. Proxy configuration can pass request headers and define the upstream address with proxy_pass.

captures.title: systemd service units
captures.text: A systemd service unit describes a process managed by systemd. Unit settings define how a service starts, restarts, and interacts with dependencies.

captures.title: Linux file permissions
captures.text: Unix file permissions are represented for user, group, and others. Read, write, and execute permissions control access, while file ownership determines which permission class applies.

captures.title: Pancake recipe
captures.text: For pancakes, combine flour, eggs, milk, and a pinch of salt into a smooth batter. Heat a lightly oiled non-stick frying pan before cooking small portions of batter.

captures.title: Pasta cooking basics
captures.text: Cook pasta in boiling water until it reaches the desired texture. Salting the water seasons the pasta, and reserving some starchy pasta water helps emulsify a sauce.

captures.title: USDA food safety
captures.text: Keep raw meat, poultry, seafood, and eggs separate from ready-to-eat foods. Refrigerate perishable food promptly and use a food thermometer to verify safe cooking temperatures.

captures.title: Web accessibility introduction
captures.text: Web accessibility means websites and tools are designed so people with disabilities can perceive, understand, navigate, and interact with them. Semantic HTML and keyboard access are foundational practices.
